tool_calls.purpose: Identify the report_schema_mapping (patient/series identifiers, quality score column, CT/mask filename mapping) and understand the data structure.
Determine the recursive_scope (flat or nested patient/date subdirectories) to map report filenames to actual file locations.

I will inspect these first before asking the user for the missing policy parameters (threshold, comparator, orphan policy).
